messages:
mkeller: marking node g-rack07-3 as quarantined after repeated GPU instability on GPU2. seeing Xid 13 + ECC uncorrected spikes. pulling jobs.

sasha: can you paste the exact dmesg lines and current ECC counters? which driver/kernel? we should do a short focused repro before any RMA.

mkeller: dmesg excerpt:\n[ 20456.112] NVRM: Xid (13) on GPU 2 at 0x0f34\n[ 20456.112] NVRM: Gpu has incurred an uncorrectable ECC error\n[ 20456.130] NVRM: Xid (13) reported\n\nDriver: 525.89.02, kernel 6.1.34\nECC counters: corrected.volatile=243, uncorrected.volatile=3 (delta +3 in last hour)

tim: ok. propose a compact reproducibility workflow: 1) single-gpu mini-stress (memrw + memcpy loops) 2) concurrent ECC poll + thermal log 3) if flaky, power-cycle and re-run 30m 4) if still flaky, swap into spare host slot and re-run.

ops-jen: booking a 3h low-traffic window tonight 01:00-04:00 for longer soak and possible hot-swap. reserving spare card.

infra-bot: quarantine applied to g-rack07-3 by mkeller. autoscheduler drained tasks. :warning:

mkeller: starting mini-repro now. using the lightweight suite:

```
sudo /usr/local/bin/gpu-diagnostic \
  --target 2 \
  --tests mem_rw,copy,burst-writes \
  --duration 45m \
  --log /var/log/gpu-diag-g-rack07-3-1937654321.log
```

also tailing ECC with:

```
watch -n 10 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile,ecc.errors.corrected.volatile,temperature.gpu --format=csv
```

sasha: add pci errors too: check `dmesg | grep -i pcie` and `lspci -vvv` before/after. if we see lane retrain messages, capture them.

mkeller: initial 25m: one Xid 13, uncorrected ECC delta +1, corrected +7. log shows memcpy error at 0x7fffa2b1. attaching tail: "memcopy failure: Xid 13 - io fault"

tim: that signature (Xid + small uncorrected) often correlates to marginal memory cell plus thermal sensitivity. next actions: 1) try cold power-cycle of the whole node 2) rerun 30m mini test 3) if repro remains, swap card into g-rack03-2 (known-good slot) and run same test.

ops-jen: please also capture fan curves and PSU telemetry. last time a PSU sag looked similar.

mkeller: ran cold power-cycle at 1937656820. rerunning 30m now.

infra-bot: Test run started by mkeller at 1937656880. logs uploading to s3://redwood-infra/gpu-logs/1937654321-mini-repro/

sasha: also try `cuda_memtest` and `memtestG80` if available. run with `--ecc-scrub` enabled where supported. collect nvlink counters if present.

mkeller: 10m after power-cycle: no Xid so far, corrected ECC steady. 35m mark: another Xid 13 appeared and uncorrected +2. looks like repro returned.

tim: reproducible after power-cycle -> more likely card-level issue. schedule swap to isolate. if repro follows card to new host -> RMA. if it stays on original slot -> suspect riser/slot or power rail.

ops-jen: planned hot-swap tomorrow 02:30. tagging @hw-ops to pre-authorize vendor RMA if swap confirms.

hw-ops: acknowledged. once you confirm repro on swapped host please open vendor case with bundle: dmesg, /var/log/gpu-diag*, nvidia-smi -q, power-cycle timestamps, and test script output. include serial and lot info from `nvidia-smi -q`.

mkeller: agreed. packaging bundle if swap reproduces. also adding service traces from inference host to correlate any customer impact: request/latency spikes during the incidence window.

sasha: escalation thresholds to document here: any uncorrected ECC delta >=1 during stress OR any Xid 13 that repeats after cold-reset -> escalate to hw-ops + vendor. repeated Xids across multiple slots within 6h -> immediate RMA.

mkeller: final note: if vendor returns same-card flaky after RMA, we need to escalate to replace riser/backplane per previous postmortems. will post final outcome after swap tomorrow. :eyes:
